segments.title: SHENZHEN SETS THE TABLE
segments.dialogue: Welcome to Global Footprints. I'm Nefertiti, with DJ Dehrtay Dog. Three world powers plan to meet in Shenzhen this week.

segments.title: COALITION INTERCEPTION REPORT
segments.dialogue: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two ballistic missiles toward Riyadh and three drones over the Eastern Province. This claim is not independently verified.

segments.title: LIBERIA TAKES THE PRESIDENCY
segments.dialogue: Liberia is scheduled to preside over the UN Security Council in December. The United Nations rotation calendar confirms the schedule.

segments.title: DONBAS FOR NATO?
segments.dialogue: Zelenskyy says US negotiators raised Donbas withdrawal in connection with NATO membership. He calls it an idea, not agreed policy. What should Ukrainians decide?

segments.title: HANDOFF TO THE MUSIC
segments.dialogue: That's Global Footprints. I'm Nefertiti. DJ Dehrtay Dog takes it from here. Stay with Micdom AI Records and enjoy the music.

Take my hand — but keep one foot in the real.
